Use for tasks where a mostly uniform background contains disconnected multi-color objects and demos recolor selected foreground cells/components.

## Caution learned from task-52cf831c

This task family may present varied palettes and geometries, where only one object or a subset of cells changes. A distinctive line or marker may determine the replacement color, while exact local motif geometry/relative placement determines which object is recolored. In task-52cf831c, eight varied demos confirmed a rule: a full-color cross/edge marker establishes a special color; when a separate object exactly duplicates a motif of another color (same normalized occupied-cell mask and orientation), recolor the duplicate object to the cross color.
